mapper.insert:
insert into CBONDANALYSISCSI (OBJECT_ID, S_INFO_WINDCODE, TRADE_DT, B_INFO_TYPE, B_INFO_LISTINGMARKETNUMBERS, B_ANAL_DIRTY_CSI, B_ANAL_YIELD_CSI, B_ANAL_MODIDURA_CSI, B_ANAL_CNVXTY_CSI, B_ANAL_NET_CSI, B_ANAL_ACCRINT_CSI,OPDATE,OPMODE) values
(#{item.objectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.sInfoWindcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.tradeDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.bInfoType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.bInfoListingmarketnumbers,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalDirtyCsi,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalYieldCsi,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalModiduraCsi,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalCnvxtyCsi,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalNetCsi,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bAnalAccrintCsi,jdbcType=DECIMAL} , #{item.opdate,jdbcType=DATE},#{item.opmode,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select A.OBJECT_ID, A.S_INFO_WINDCODE, date_format(STR_TO_DATE(A.TRADE_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DT, A.B_INFO_TYPE, A.B_INFO_LISTINGMARKETNUMBERS, A.B_ANAL_DIRTY_CSI, ifnull(A.B_ANAL_YIELD_CSI/100,NULL) B_ANAL_YIELD_CSI, A.B_ANAL_MODIDURA_CSI, A.B_ANAL_CNVXTY_CSI, A.B_ANAL_NET_CSI, A.B_ANAL_ACCRINT_CSI, A.OPDATE,A.OPMODE from CBONDANALYSISCSI A WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT B WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE='F01' AND A.S_INFO_WINDCODE = B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID ) AND A.TRADE_DT = #{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
